statements.t: In women, we reported positive Phase 2 results in the open-label Study ‘207,’ and completed enrollment in the registration-directed Phase 2/3 Study ‘306,’ with topline data on track for the first half of 2027,” said Reid Waldman, M.D., Chief Executive Officer of Veradermics.
The Company expects to report topline data in the first half of 2027.
